## Activity

During April 2021, East City Eye Clinic recorded 119 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity provides the basis for the subsequent review of image quality and grading outcomes. The reported volume should be considered alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed as part of the routine review. There were 3 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 2.5. This rate records the proportion of captures that could not proceed through grading because the images were not suitable for assessment. The figures provide the monthly measure of image usability for East City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 27 referable results during April 2021. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This is the reported median time for results to move from image capture to completion of grading. Together, the referable total and median lag summarise the grading outcomes and timeliness recorded for the month.
